samples.question: On a white canvas a field of many small dark dots is scattered. Taken together the dots leave one large empty void -- a clear region with no dots -- that is clearly larger than every other opening in the field. Four small coloured dots (red, green, blue, orange) are placed on the canvas. Exactly one coloured dot sits inside that largest empty void, far away from every dark dot; the other three sit right among the dark dots. Which coloured dot sits in the largest empty void? Choose: red, green, blue, or orange.
